items.q: We pay for exchange DI. When does a package make sense?
items.a: When your daily use exceeds [exchange DI breakeven, L/day]. Below that, exchange deionization (DI) can cost less. USP <1231> warns that exchange canisters can contaminate the water. Send your daily use and exchange cost with your budget request.

items.q: When is polypropylene the wrong choice?
items.a: When the loop must run hot. Natural polypropylene (PP) is rated 0 to 80 °C, and its pressure rating falls as it heats.

items.q: Can you supply one part, or should one supplier design it all?
items.a: [Whether single modules are supplied alone]. We design pretreatment, generation and distribution as one package. Interface limits go in the functional specification; we test our scope at the factory acceptance test (FAT).

items.q: How do we size generation against storage?
items.a: From your point-of-use demand over a full production day. Generation covers average demand plus sanitization and tank refill; the tank covers the peaks. We share the calculation.

items.q: Do you build to standard platforms or to order?
items.a: [standard platforms, capacity ranges, lead time in weeks]. Either way, we adapt instruments and controls to your user requirement specification (URS).
